content.short: Open-source software for a decentralized world.
content.description:
We believe that blockchain adoption can be accelerated by improving developer experience.

We develop blockchain tools, leveraging the open-source community and its methodologies. We incubate open-source projects intended to make development easier on Cardano. We look forward community participation to improve Cardano adoption and growth. So far Txpipe projects include Scrolls, Oura, Pallas, Aiken, Demeter, Boros, and Dolos.
